FULL TEXT:
COMPUTER OPERATOR-CUM-TYPIST RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2026
NOTICE
No.- 40/R&A Dated: 14th July, 2026
This is for information to all concerned that Computer Based Written Test
(MCQ + English Computer Typing Test + Hindi Computer Typing Test) for
Computer Operator-cum-Typist Recruitment Examination, 2026 (under
Advertisement No. PHC/02/2026 dated 10.04.2026) is scheduled to be held on
22.07.2026 (Wednesday) in two shifts (9:00 AM-10:30 AM & 01:00 PM-02:30 PM) at
various examination centres situated in Patna and Muzaffarpur.
Admit Cards of eligible candidates shall be available on the official website of the
High Court i.e. https://patnahighcourt.gov.in, on 15.07.2026 from 12:00 pm onwards.
Intimation in this regard will be sent to the candidates through SMS and email on their
registered mobile number and e-mail ID. Admit Card would not be sent to the candidates
separately through any other mode. Examination centres once allotted to the candidates
shall be final and no communication with regard to change of examination centre shall be
entertained. The candidates are directed to strictly follow the instructions mentioned in the
Admit Card. The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s website regularly for
further details/updates.
By order
Sd/-
Registrar General I/c
